profile.name: Arlème Johnson
profile.tagline: I build fullstack apps and tools that make developers faster — with AI where it actually helps.
profile.location: Based in Antananarivo, Madagascar. Shipping from Linux, UTC+3.
about: I'm a fullstack developer based in Antananarivo. I build with Python and FastAPI on the back end and Vue.js on the front, then ship with Docker and GitHub Actions, all from a Linux setup I keep tuning.
Right now I'm going deeper into LLM training and building tools that make developer workflows faster. Off-screen, I practise kendo.

featured.title: Nirvix
featured.summary: Build your character: an RPG-style life app where every finished quest levels up one of six character stats. Local-first, on Linux and Android.
featured.imageAlt: Nirvix home screen: character sheet with a radar chart of six stats, level and the Nix mascot

projects.title: OddsLab
projects.summary: A paper-betting lab: collects real odds, compares them with a sharp bookmaker and simulates strategies. No real money, ever.

projects.title: Alandia

projects.title: Open-source contributions
projects.summary: Malagasy translation for wttr.in, the WebSearch module, Malagasy phone numbers for validator.js.

process: Scope, data model and edge cases written down before any code exists.
AI drafts, I decide: architecture, naming and trade-offs stay mine.
Tests, review and CI on every change, deployed with Docker and GitHub Actions.
